tools.name: list_my_listings
tools.description: List the user's OWN listings (any status), newest first. Resolved from the authenticated agent key — only ever returns this user's listings. Use status='pending' to see what is awaiting moderation, status='rejected' for declined ones.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List the user's OWN listing-message conversations (threads they started, or received as a listing owner), newest first. Resolved from the authenticated agent key — only ever this user's threads. Use get_conversation to read a thread's messages.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Read one of the user's OWN message conversations by thread_id, including its messages (marks incoming messages read). Only threads the authenticated user participates in are returned.

tools.name: get_entitlements
tools.description: Check the user's publishing entitlements BEFORE attempting to publish: membership tier, max vs current active listings, remaining slots, wallet credit balance, the per-listing credit cost, and can_create_listing. tools.description: Edit fields (title, description, price, currency, location, details) on one of the USER'S OWN listings, identified by listing_id. tools.name: delete_listing
tools.description: Delete (soft-delete) one of the USER'S OWN listings by listing_id. Only the owner can delete. No credit is refunded — the listing was already published.

tools.name: set_listing_status
tools.description: Change the lifecycle status of one of the USER'S OWN listings: mark it sold, hide it (take it offline), or re-activate a hidden one. Free — no credit charge. Cannot set moderation states (pending/rejected); re-activating only works on a listing that was previously approved and is currently hidden.

tools.name: renew_listing
tools.description: Renew one of the USER'S OWN listings — reset its expiry to 30 days from now (native listings lapse ~30 days after posting). Free — no credit charge. Renewing an expired listing returns it to active; a pending, rejected, sold, or draft listing cannot be renewed.

tools.name: reply_to_conversation
tools.description: Continue an EXISTING message thread by thread_id — the message goes to the other participant. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_conversations, get_conversation, reply_to_conversation · Private data: get_listing, send_message, create_listing, get_entitlements, reply_to_conversation, update_listing_images · Public sink: search_listings, send_message, create_listing, request_image_upload, get_entitlements, update_listing, update_listing_images · Destructive: delete_listing, renew_listing, update_listing_images.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_conversations, get_conversation, reply_to_conversation · Private data: get_listing, send_message, create_listing, get_entitlements, reply_to_conversation, update_listing_images · Public sink: search_listings, send_message, create_listing, request_image_upload, get_entitlements, update_listing, update_listing_images · Destructive: delete_listing, renew_listing, update_listing_images

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
